releases.name: Tile-topia 2026-11-18
releases.body: Created Tile-topia, a tile placing game where you build a map one tile at a time and score finished features. Added Longest Road, Biggest Castle, and Longest River records. Added a Cyber skin with animated lanes and placement effects, a Graphite on paper skin, and an isometric view toggle. Added completion chimes, a record celebration, player outlines, and bot opponents. Redrew the City skin as detailed illustrations with lit 3D buildings and added the full River tile set.

releases.name: Tile-topia 2026-11-19
releases.body: Added an Auto build mode that places tiles in spots that avoid gaps. It builds only inside the view and leaves fog beyond it. Added connector tiles for every edge combination, and holes now fill automatically.

jobs.description: A tile placing game where you build a map and score finished lanes, districts, and cores.

releases.name: Cipher Wars 2026-11-18
releases.body: Created Cipher Wars version 3. It adds a warm up round before the campaigns begin. Players read a briefing, make a choice, and earn intel points toward a final rank, with a codex and a list of key figures to look things up.

jobs.description: A story game about a secret war of codes where you play the codemaker or the codebreaker.

releases.name: Circuit Visualizer 2026-06-26
releases.body: Created Circuit Visualizer, a music visualizer that draws a circuit board and lights it on beats. Added reactive hits, per band circuits, and flashing. Added a bead train tempo display, a hamburger menu, and a drop legend. Five circuits now cross fade with the tempo and hold longer.

releases.name: Circuit Visualizer 2026-06-28
releases.body: Circuits cross fade with the tempo and hold longer. Added RF antennas, an LED spectrum bank, and denser components.

releases.name: Circuit Visualizer 2026-09-11
releases.body: Added ASCII bars and matrix rain modes. Leads now have vias, the core halo is tighter, and the LED strip is chained. Submenus collapse and there is a terminal theme system.

releases.name: Circuit Visualizer 2026-11-18
releases.body: Added Bitfield mode, brought over from the Bitfield Synth app.

jobs.description: A music visualizer that draws a circuit board that lights up to the beat.

releases.name: Bee Wars 2026-11-18
releases.body: Created Bee Wars, a territory control game with two bee colonies in one meadow. You win by growing to 21 bees or by killing the rival queen. Send workers, soldiers, and scouts around the map, paint walls, and pick what each new bee will be.

jobs.description: A territory control game where two bee colonies compete for pollen and land.

releases.name: DEF CON Trail 2026-11-18
releases.body: Created DEF CON Trail version 1, a trail style travel game about getting a crew to a hacker conference in Las Vegas. Crew members now carry local groups by area code, and groups meet at night. Shops sell a first timer kit. A hand drawn Las Vegas skyline pans to each landmark. Added pool parties, badge shorts, soldering burns, lockpick fingertips, blisters, brutal heat, monsoon floats, and deodorant, plus a go up to go down elevator rule after tower parties.

jobs.description: A trail style travel game about getting a crew to a hacker conference in Las Vegas.

releases.name: Atlas of Tiles 2026-11-18
releases.body: Added Pipes challenge levels, Pipe Rush, and Visualizer modes, and the tradition styles became skins. Pipes gained rocks, bridges, pinned tiles, triangle and octagon grids, and intro cards. Added a Vault challenge where you reveal five digits and crack the code, with difficulty levels. Rush, Pipes, and Vault scores post to the score hub. Added pipe styles, Big boards in three sizes, synth sounds with a mute button, and a Circuit style with AC and DC boards. Added Cyber, Color Pop, and Escher Remix skins.

jobs.description: Tile rotating puzzle where closed loops score, with regional tile styles.

releases.name: Bitfield Synth 2026-11-18
releases.body: A mobile control dock now replaces the hamburger drawer.

jobs.description: Pixel field visualizer driven by math expressions, audio, and images.

releases.name: Hackercons Roulette API 2026-11-18
releases.body: Newest talks now come first. Added a fresh talk pool and a fresh filter.

jobs.description: Catalog service that serves random playable conference clips to the player.

releases.name: Hackercons Roulette 2026-11-18
releases.body: Redesigned the player in a comic book look. Added a fresh only filter and sound effect bursts.

jobs.description: Plays random short clips from hacker conference talks with a guessing mode.

releases.name: Welcome to the Madness 2026-11-18
releases.body: The shift over screen now shows a top five shifts board.

jobs.description: A kitchen rush game where you pull orders before they burn.

releases.name: Pipe Weave 2026-11-18
releases.body: Added highways, roundabouts, intersections, fabric weaves, stair presets, a stair skin, and picture stamps. Added a Cityscape preset and a Join weave mode.

jobs.description: A pipe drawing toy where pipes turn, split, and weave over and under each other.

releases.name: App Index 2026-11-18
releases.body: Apps that were unsorted now sit in categories. A new category was tried and then removed, and apps went back to their old spots. The menu now floats over the page in the retro and future looks, and the future look has stars behind the links and plain striped section titles. Sync now resets to GitHub first and only deploys after a good push.

releases.name: App Index 2026-11-19
releases.body: Added a sticky notes view where a mannequin wears a fitted gown made of one note per app. Added wall, car, semi trailer, 747, and wind scenes for the notes. Sync now refreshes the Vercel login first and still deploys if the app list read fails.

jobs.description: An index page that lists every app with its age, phone tags, and notes.
